# Hamster Server

> Hamster Server is a free, open-source (MIT), portable local web server for Windows 10 and 11 (x64). It bundles Apache HTTP Server 2.4.68 and PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5 with a native control panel that generates all Apache and php.ini configuration, installs PHP patch updates automatically while keeping user-added extensions, manages virtual hosts with framework presets, and shows which program holds a port. Current version: 1.4.1 (released 2026-11-02). Made by Konex Forge.

Key facts:

- Platform: Windows 10/11 x64. Requires the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. No installer, no administrator rights; it runs from any writable folder.
- Bundled: Apache 2.4.68 (Apache Lounge, VS18 Win64); PHP 8.2.35-1, 8.3.36-1, 8.4.27-1, 8.5.12-1 (Non Thread Safe, x64; patched against PHP2Shell, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619). Not bundled: MySQL/MariaDB or any database server.
- PHP updates: checks php.net a minute after start and every six hours. Default mode "Install automatically" installs the newer patch of the active branch side by side and switches while idle; also "Notify me only" and "Off". Never changes branch on its own. Recognises Windows rebuild versions such as 8.5.12-1.
- Extensions: DLLs the user added to a runtime's ext folder (e.g. sqlsrv, pdo_sqlsrv, Xdebug, imagick) are copied into the new patch of the same branch; never across branches.
- Virtual hosts: presets for Laravel, Symfony, WordPress, Drupal, Magento, CodeIgniter, Yii, CakePHP, Phalcon, Slim and Hyperf; checks the Windows hosts file; *.localhost names need no hosts entry.
- Ports: a System ports view lists every listening TCP port with program and PID and marks the program blocking Apache or PHP.
- Network: Apache listens on 127.0.0.1 unless LAN access is enabled. The only outside connection is HTTPS to windows.php.net / downloads.php.net; downloads are installed only when their SHA-256 matches. No telemetry.
